daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ﴾: the hamza is a particle of interrogation and affirmation (taqrīr), and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lam, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿صَدْرَكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿وَوَضَعْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿عَنْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿وِزْرَكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective) of وزرك; ﴿أَنْقَضَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿ظَهْرَكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿وَرَفَعْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿ذِكْرَكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle and ﴿إن﴾ is a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters); ﴿مَعَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of inna; ﴿الْعُسْرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿يُسْراً﴾: the postponed noun of inna; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:6-6.t: A tawkīd (emphasis) of the preceding verse.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; ﴿إذا﴾: a conditional adverb that does not put the verb in the jussive; ﴿فَرَغْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿فَانْصَبْ﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa), and an imperative verb whose agent is latent (mustatir); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position, and the clause إذا… is resumptive.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿وَإِلى رَبِّكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what follows them; ﴿فَارْغَبْ﴾: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.
